_meta.session: Session 90 — GPT-5.5 Safety + Gemini suite + MAI suite + Anthropic gap + web sources
_meta.notes: Major mining batch — 14 PDFs + 3 web sources. Key SOTAs: Gemini 3 Pro (~17 SOTAs, HLE 45.8, GPQA-D 91.9, AIME-25 100% w/code, ScreenSpot-Pro 72.7, Vending-Bench 2 $5478). GPT-5.5 Cyber Range 93.33%, UK AISI 90.5%. MAI Thinking 1 AIME-25 97.0. Arena GPT-Image-2-Medium 1465 Elo #1. CyberGym GPT-5 22% + 22 zero-days. ExploitGym Mythos Preview 226 exploits. Anthropic gap: USAMO 2026 Opus 4.8 96.7%, BioMysteryBench, Legal Agent, FrontierSWE, ArxivMath.
